Portrait: Off-duty dorm clothes: a soft oversized hoodie or long-sleeve T-shirt, loose drawstring sweatpants and indoor slippers or thick socks. Relaxed and slightly rumpled, no prints or lettering. Default colors: heather gray with one soft pastel. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
